description: PROCEDURE DIVISION … RETURNING, §2023:14.2 - the RETURNING phrase is 2002+. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 header is 'PROCEDURE DIVISION [ USING { data-name-1 } … ] .' (§1985:X.5.1), with no RETURNING phrase; the 2002 header is 'PROCEDURE DIVISION [ using-phrase ] [ RETURNING data-name-2 ]' (§2002:14.1.1) and 'The RETURNING phrase may be specified in a method definition, a program definition, or a program prototype' (§2002:14.1.2 SR4), and §2002:F.1 item 6 ('The following reserved words have been added') lists RETURNING. 2014 keeps it (§2014:14.2.1; §2014:14.2.2 SR4).
